analysis.summary: This work tests constraint checking implementations -- the components that verify consistency constraints over software artifacts in context-aware and pervasive computing systems -- using principled metamorphic transformations. Applying its metamorphic relations to nine variants of three implementations, it detected bugs in seven of the nine and found five unique implementation bugs that had gone undetected for months to years.
analysis.narrative: No relationship is visible in the paper's own text. Its bibliography resolves to no SQLancer publication, and its subject is constraint checking over software models rather than database query evaluation; the only near-match in the text is the word 'trigger'. The record's presence among SQLancer-citing papers comes from the upstream citation graph rather than from anything found in the paper, and that should be re-examined.
